{{Top|leg}}
[[File:GreatMeet.jpg|thumb|250px|The Great Meet in 12 ABY is interrupted by [[Drub McKumb]].]]
A '''Herd Meet''', '''Great Meet''', or '''Time of Meeting''' occurred as the [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]]' [[Ithorian Herdship|Herdships]] met once in every three [[Standard year/Legends|years]].<ref name="TMTS">''[[The Movie Trilogy Sourcebook]]''</ref> The ships would return from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] to [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]]; their interaction and joint maneuvering was described as 'impressive' and 'beautiful.'<ref name="CotJ">[[Children of the Jedi (novel)|''Children of the Jedi'']]</ref>

Around [[14 BBY/Legends|14 BBY]], [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] represented the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] in a herd meet and took [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] along to see it. In [[12 ABY/Legends|12 ABY]], Leia returned as the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] representative with her [[Han Solo/Legends|husband]], her family, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|her brother]] and other New Republic representatives of that year's Herd Meet.<ref name="CotJ" />
